title: Product release coordination
description: Coordinate eligible product releases around an exact qualified candidate, applicable publication authority, observed external identity, and recoverable reporting outcomes.
responsibilities: Determine eligible release identity and prepare profile-owned projections without inventing upstream version or compatibility decisions.
Qualify and retain a candidate, bind publication authority to it, and perform only its authorized publication steps.
Observe actual public outcomes, retain durable closeout, and select recovery from known external state rather than blindly repeating uncertain writes.
owned_state: Release preparation context, retained candidate references, qualification/authorization associations, and publication observations and closeout records; source product definitions and registry state remain distinct authorities.

includes: Routine release coordination, preparation, qualification, publication, observation, and recovery within the current Release contract.
excludes: Novel product decisions inside routine publication, approval inferred from a test pass, mutable release identities, claiming public success from local generation, or republishing to repair lost reporting.

design_limits: Existing Release owns channels, exact candidate identity, authorization, external-write failure classes, and closeout. This draft does not approve or execute a release.
Shared authority/evidence Functions retain MOD-006/MOD-007 ownership; detailed collaboration Interfaces and ARs are deferred.
Realization mapping and full migration of source-specific maintenance obligations remain separate work.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.
